title: Multiphysics coupling: one-way, partitioned with Aitken, monolithic, checked
description: Two physics participants through named interface fields, coupled one-way, two-way partitioned (Gauss-Seidel with Aitken relaxation) and monolithically; the strategy from the measured coupling strength; convergence, interface balance and a closed-form coupled solution (pinneapple_simulation.multiphysics.workflow).
